caseName: Federal Mining & Smelting Co. v. Star Mining Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Mining & Smelting Company v. Star Mining Company

opinions.text: December 13,1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied. Mr. John A. Marshall and Mr. Frederick W. Lehmann for petitioner. Mr. John P. Gray and Mr. James A. Wayne for respondent.
